icons.name: id-card
icons.heading: ID card
icons.description: The card is read and the holder's details fill in. Light: the photo pops as the identity is captured, then the first detail line writes out to full length and the second follows a beat later; the details stay. Strong: the card taps down onto a reader and springs back, the photo pops harder, and the two lines write out in turn, each stopping crisply at full length. The preview reset fades the details back to their stubs.

icons.name: passkey
icons.heading: Passkey
icons.description: The passkey lets the person in. Light: the key turns 30 degrees like a key in a lock and stops dead (the click), holds, and turns back quickly; the click sends one arc out of the bow towards the person, and a beat later the account holder hops up, signed in, and lands. Strong: the key winds back first, turns further and bounces on the click, and the person hops higher, then once more, smaller.

icons.name: face-authentication
icons.heading: Face authentication
icons.description: The face is scanned and recognised. Light: a scan line appears at the top of the frame, sweeps down over the face and fades; as it finishes, the four corner brackets snap in onto the face (hit), rebound and settle. Strong: the scan sweeps down and back up, the brackets lock on harder with a bounce, and the face gives a small nod of acceptance.

icons.name: private-browsing
icons.heading: Private browsing
icons.description: Going incognito. Light: the glasses are pushed up and, a beat later, both lenses darken into shades with a highlight (left, then right), hold while the glasses drop back and settle, then clear. Strong: a dip, a higher push and a second sly lift (a double eyebrow raise) while the shades darken and stay dark longer before they clear. The highlight keeps each lens open, as the set's native-opening rule requires.

icons.name: cookie-preferences
icons.heading: Cookie preferences
icons.description: Preferences get set. Light: the cookie clicks round like a dial (12 degrees, stops dead) and its chips switch on one after another as it passes them, each popping and settling, before the sprung dial returns. Strong: the dial winds back first, clicks further round, and the chips pop larger in turn while the dial springs home in two swings.
